d:
Jharkhand ke mukhyamantri hemant soren ne yuvaon aur mahilaon ko lekar kaee aham ailan kie hain. ab rajy men betiyan bhi nait shipht men kam kar sakengi. vahin, 15 yuvaon ko kamarshiyal paylat banane ki pahal ki jaegi.
Mukhyamantri ke in ailanon se mahilaon ke rojgar aur yuvaon ke lie nae avasron ki ummid jagi hai. aakhir kya hai sarkar ka pura plan? dekhie is riport men.
